forum.title: User's profile page doesn't show date  joined
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil,

indeed, this information is not available on the frontend anymore.

As a workaround, you can check on the user profile the oldest reply or post to get the idea on when their first engagement took place: [Replies posted by Andrew Neil | Community](https://community.st.com/search/activity/reactions/index530.html?userid=35659&sort=dateline.desc)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9737a543-62c6-421b-834e-94aa95a25290.png)

Let me know if you have any questions.

Kind regards,

Lina
